results.note: Praefatio in Evangelia (Preface to the Four Gospels) is included in NPNF2-06 Jerome: The Principal Works, translated by W.H. Fremantle. Addressed to Pope Damasus, A.D. 383. Available online at ccel.org.

Praefationes aliae (Other Prefaces) are included in NPNF2-06 Jerome collection, translated by W.H. Fremantle et al. The Patrologia Latina Database references this work as a medieval text (v029.6). Available in NPNF2-06.

De formis Hebraicarum litterarum (On the Forms of Hebrew Letters) - No English translation found. Search results show the work survives in medieval manuscripts (British Library Anglo-Saxon manuscript), but no published English translation exists.

Vita S. Pauli (Life of Paulus the First Hermit) is included in NPNF2-06 Jerome, translated by W.H. Fremantle (1893). Also available in other editions by White (1998) and Ewald (1952). NPNF version at ccel.org/ccel/schaff/npnf206.vi.i.html.

Prologus - Refers to Jerome's Prologus Galeatus (Preface to Samuel and Kings), included in NPNF2-06 as 'Preface to the Books of Samuel and Kings,' translated by W.H. Fremantle (1893). Available online in NPNF2-06.

Commentaria in Amos - Translated by Thomas P. Scheck in Jerome: Commentaries on the Twelve Prophets, Volume 2, InterVarsity Press/Ancient Christian Texts series, 2017. Also included in minor prophets collections by Robin MacGregor.
Commentaria in Danielem - Translated by Gleason L. Archer, published by Baker Book House in 1958. First English translation of Jerome's Commentary on Daniel. Available online at tertullian.org.
Commentaria in Ezechielem - Translated by Thomas P. Scheck, Paulist Press/Ancient Christian Writers series, vol. 71. First modern translation of Jerome's second longest Old Testament commentary.

Commentaria in Jonam - Multiple translations exist: Thomas P. Scheck in IVP Ancient Christian Texts, Volume 1 (2016); Robin MacGregor, 2014, published in Consolamini Commentary Series; and Tim Hegedus, 1991 (thesis). The Scheck IVP edition is the most recent standard.

Commentaria in Michaeam - Translated by Thomas P. Scheck in Jerome: Commentaries on the Twelve Prophets, Volume 1, InterVarsity Press/Ancient Christian Texts series, 2016. Also earlier thesis translation by Anthony Cazares (Ave Maria, 2013).
Commentaria in Osee - Translated by Thomas P. Scheck in Jerome: Commentaries on the Twelve Prophets, Volume 2, InterVarsity Press/Ancient Christian Texts series, 2017.

De X nominibus Dei (On the Ten Names of God) - This may be a variant title or section of Jerome's De nominibus Hebraicis (Book on Hebrew Names). A Wikisource page exists for 'De X nominibus Dei' discussing ten divine names. Status unclear whether this is a separate work or part of the De nominibus Hebraicis included in NPNF2-06.

De nominibus Hebraicis (Book on the Interpretation of Hebrew Names) - Fremantle translation included in NPNF2-06 Jerome (page 485). Based on Philo, expanded by Origen, written by Jerome around 389/391. Available in NPNF2-06 at ccel.org.

Liber Proverbiorum - Jerome's Preface to Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, and Song of Songs (the Books of Solomon), dedicated to Chromatius and Heliodorus, A.D. 393/404. Included in NPNF2-06 as part of 'Prefaces to the Books of the Vulgate Version of the Old Testament,' translated by W.H. Fremantle et al. This is the preface, not a full commentary.
